theme: An open day to close out the last travel bookings.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. Nothing sits on the calendar today, which is exactly the room you need to lock down the final Croatia and St. Pete bookings before those windows tighten.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 night in Cavtat
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board since Aug 23 — one night after the charter disembarks and before your 7:30 AM DBV flight. Mike wants Cavtat by the airport, not Old Town.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Croatia bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: Due today on the board — the issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Eurowings Discover. Verify the allowance on the operating carrier's own site and buy bags now if they aren't included; counter fees run far higher.

needsAttention.title: Book the St. Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Due today — two nights (Sept 20–21) in St. Pete after you land TPA and before the Tue kid pickup. Also worth a glance that the pending St. Pete Airbnb converted to confirmed.

recipe.title: Salmon Baked in Foil
recipe.why: High summer wants the lightest possible touch on good fish, letting the season's herbs and heat do the work.

acts.line: No meetings anywhere on the calendar this morning — the day starts entirely open.
The open stretch runs straight through the afternoon, with nothing scheduled to break it.
The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete, so the evening lands close to home.
